testcase.name: Scenario: Decline replacing an existing part during first save: git/oblikovati-workspace/oblikovati-rust/target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:271:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Decline replacing an existing part during first save ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user presses Control+S to open Save As ✔ And the Save As dialog is open for a new part in the MCAD Software ✔ And the current folder is a writable copy of `fixtures/cad/document-saving/SaveAsNativeFolder` with its existing part files ✔ When the user selects `ExistingPart.opd` ✔ And the user chooses Save ✔ Then a confirmation identifies the existing file and asks whether to replace it ✔ And the confirmation offers Yes and No ✔ And the Save As dialog remains behind the confirmation ✔ When the user chooses No ✔ Then the confirmation closes ✔ And Save As remains open with the existing file name displayed ✔ When the user cancels Save As ✔ Then the new unsaved part remains active
